from pocket_coffea.workflows.base_processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        events = self.events
        
        # Build MuonGood collection
        muons = events.Muon
        muon_good = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        events["MuonGood"] = muon_good
        
        return events
    
    def object_counting(self, events, required_cuts):
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.count(events.MuonGood.pt, axis=1)
        return events
